tests.name: suspended_job_bound_redirected_io
tests.evidence: The child was created suspended with PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST and the exact inherited-handle list, the Job active-process count was 1 before resume, stdin/stdout/stderr round-tripped PING/PING/ERR, exit was 0, and the Job returned to 0 active processes.

tests.name: kill_on_close_host_failure_boundary
tests.evidence: A suspended job-bound 60-second child was resumed, the anonymous Job handle was closed without an explicit terminate call, and the child exited within 5 seconds.
